title: Heartstopper: Volume One
author: Alice Oseman
summary: A graphic novel set at a British boys' school. Charlie, who is openly gay, ends up sitting next to Nick, a friendly rugby player, and their friendship begins to turn into something more.
readIf: you want a sweet, quick, illustrated love story that feels safe and kind.
skipIf: you want a long, complex plot, since this first volume is light and short.

pairings.reason: A warm, funny coming-out story of first love among teenagers, in prose.
A quieter, more reflective story of two boys discovering what they mean to each other.
A grown-up, comic romance with the same sweetness and an enemies-to-lovers heart.
